Yes, there are two kinds. Neither is made by Tesla, so both are aftermarket.

## 1. Rear-seat display (the most common choice)
These are 8.66" Android touchscreens that plug into the back of the center console. They stream video, support wireless CarPlay/Android Auto, and control rear AC and seat heating. Most listings cover Model Y 2019-2024 only, so a 2025+ "Juniper" may not fit. Confirm your model year before buying.

Options from the results:
- **Best balance: 8.66" Rear Display, 4GB+64GB, Android 13, about $330.** It has the most reviews of the Amazon options (3.9 stars, 41 ratings). [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen)
- **Cheaper: "Made for Model 3 Model Y" 8.66" screen, about $280.** It's rated 4.5 stars, but from only 2 ratings, so that score isn't reliable. [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen)
- **Budget: Tlyard 8.66", about $211.** It has a single rating, and delivery is listed as Nov 4-13. [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen)
- **Tesery 8.66", $359 (fits Model Y 2020 to March 2025).** It's rated 4.7 stars across 22 reviews, but the written reviews are mixed. One reviewer reported lag, a screen that keeps locking itself, and apps that won't finish updating. [Tesery](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla)

Expect some lag and software quirks from any of these. Ratings are mostly in the 3-4 star range, so buy from a seller with an easy return policy. Tesery offers 30-day returns.

## 2. Projector screen (if you want movies while parked)
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in fabric screen and sunshade for the rear window or panoramic roof, and it needs no wiring. It's built for the 2025-2026 Model Y. On 2020-2024 cars it only works in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.

You must supply your own portable projector, and it's for parked use only. A third-party deal site, [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y), says code CJ10 takes $11.99 off. I haven't verified that myself, and the site earns an affiliate commission.

## My recommendation
- **Kids watching on the road, 2019-2024 Model Y:** get the 4GB+64GB Android 13 rear display (about $330).
- **2025+ Model Y, or only parked movie nights:** get the Aurzen TravelPlay.

If you tell me your model year and whether this is for kids while driving, I can narrow it down.
